experiment: UDP6 NA joint-relation diagnostic short gate
head: 73a43b061b4c85c9d01da1a88e1b102dec850244
interpretation: Actual Linux and Windows each passed 770 required scoped tests with zero skips; this is not the entire repository test suite.

Diagnostic v4 appends a five-bit presence set of per-event NA relation patterns and an unknown-NA count. It reports combinations actually observed, not frequencies or cross-event marginal inference. Presence bits 0..4 represent joint patterns 8, 9, 10, 12, 15 for source==G, target==G, source==target and fixed-destination truth. Missing or tainted ordinary witness readiness or incomplete target bytes produce unknown, not false comparisons.

These are unauthenticated byte relationships, even when recorded before a later checksum or flag refusal. A fixed private NA-event counter validates the projection; a truncated public type/code table cannot necessarily reconstruct that total. No raw address is exported.

Inner packet schema 2, strict ND profile, bit 6 fixture-address refusal, opaque_protocol and all packet-absence formulas remain unchanged. Exact narrow reverse-AST checks preserve the original witness/profile/decode/evaluate behavior aside from the new diagnostic call.

Worst-case complete nested indent2 serialization including final newline is 4092 bytes under the unchanged 4096 projection limit. The 9402-byte full-host composition is a measurement, not a newly imposed whole-artifact cap. Native 32768, guest 4096 and private 65536 limits remain unchanged.

Actual hosted TEST_ONLY IPv6 loopback mechanics, isolated production-input verification, inert Bash/PS/ZIP prerequisites and Linux paused no-guest QEMU provenance all succeeded. Hosted contained is a fixture phase, not AppContainer isolation; valid production network CLI and Windows guest VM were not run. Existing production invalid-CLI checks remain distinct from no-PE isolated verification.

All seven hosted child owners and two receivers reported cleanup and owned-work removal. Direct Bash exit is not proof of descendant-tree termination; inert/provenance mocks are not real guest evidence.

Runtime06 remains failed/inconclusive: two strict NS qualified and one NA had source!=G OR target!=G, possibly both. The exact failed comparison cannot be recovered from its deleted raw capture. This new diagnostic does not retrospectively identify that branch or change earlier runtime results.

No new guest run was launched. This short gate does not establish real guest packet absence, universal IPv6 no-egress, address ownership, actor attribution, DNS/proxy, descendant IPv6, Linux parity or product acceptance.
